# Temple Scroll Column 54 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** 11Q19 (Cave 11), Col. 54 | **Condition:** well preserved

---

**54:1** You shall not lend-at-interest to your brother: interest of silver, interest of food, interest of any thing which is lent-at-interest.

**54:2** To the foreigner you may lend-at-interest, but to your brother you shall not lend-at-interest, so that the LORD your God may bless you in every sending-forth of your hand upon the land which you are going there to possess it.

**54:3** When you vow a vow to the LORD your God, you shall not delay to pay it, for seeking, the LORD your God will seek it from you, and it shall be in you a sin.

**54:4** But if you refrain from vowing, it shall not be in you a sin.

**54:5** The going-forth of your lips you shall keep and do, as you have vowed to the LORD your God a free-will offering which you spoke with your mouth.

**54:6** When you come into the vineyard of your neighbor, you may eat grapes according to your soul, to-your-satisfaction, but into your vessel you shall not place any.

**54:7** When you come into the standing-grain of your neighbor, you may pluck ears with your hand, but a sickle you shall not swing upon the standing-grain of your neighbor.

**54:8** When a man takes a wife and marries her, and it happens that she does not find favor in his eyes because he has found in her a thing of nakedness, then he shall write for her a document of cutting-off and place it in her hand and send her from his house.

**54:9** And she goes out from his house and goes and becomes another man's wife.

**54:10** And the latter man hates her and writes for her a document of cutting-off and places it in her hand and sends her from his house, or if the latter man dies who took her for himself as a wife —

**54:11** her first husband who sent her away is not able to return to take her to be for him a wife after she has been made-unclean, for it is an abomination before the LORD; and you shall not cause the land to sin which the LORD your God is giving to you as an inheritance.

**54:12** When a man takes a new wife, he shall not go out with the army, and nothing shall pass upon him; he shall be free for his house one year and shall gladden his wife whom he has taken.

**54:13** You shall not take-as-a-pledge a millstone or an upper-millstone, for he is taking-as-a-pledge a soul.

**54:14** If a man is found stealing a soul from among his brothers, from the sons of Israel, and he deals-as-a-slave with him or sells him, then that thief shall die; and you shall burn out the evil from your midst.

**54:15** Take-heed in the affliction of skin-disease, to keep very carefully; according to all that the Levitical priests instruct you, as I commanded them, you shall keep to do.

**54:16** Remember what the LORD your God did to Miriam on the way when you came out from Egypt.

---

*EMET notes: Column 54 reworks Deuteronomy 23:19-24:9. "Document of cutting-off" (sefer keritut) rendered literally for the divorce certificate. "Thing of nakedness" (ervat davar) preserved as the ambiguous grounds for divorce. "Skin-disease" for tsara'at — avoiding the misleading traditional "leprosy." "Sending-forth of hand" preserves the Hebrew idiom for undertaking.*
